title: The Year the Web Went Visual
narrative: Mosaic puts images on the same page as text and the Web becomes something you want to look at. The number of servers grows 300-fold in a year. Windows 3.1 lands on desks everywhere, and the browser stops being a research tool and starts being a habit.
